title: Fuse LayerNorm + residual add (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
N=32 rows, D=8 features, one thread per row.
transaction_ratio is the candidate's measured transactions divided by an UNFUSED two-kernel (write x+residual, then read it back for LayerNorm) baseline the grader runs itself through the simulator.

A single-kernel solution that still writes x+residual into `out` first and reads it back measures the SAME transaction count as the true 2-kernel baseline -- fusion has to happen in registers, not just in kernel count.
